scenes.say: Ever wonder what actually drives a Maven build? Let's break down the POM file and see why it matters.

scenes.label: Coordinates
scenes.sub: Group, artifact, and version uniquely identify your project.
scenes.say: First, every POM starts with coordinates—group, artifact, and version. These three details make your project unique in the Maven world.
You'll also see sections for dependencies, plugins, build settings, and modules. Each one shapes how your project is built and managed.
Here's a simple POM. You can quickly spot where to add dependencies or change project details.

scenes.question: Does every module need a full POM?
scenes.wrong: Yes, each module must repeat all config.
scenes.right: No, modules can inherit from a parent POM for shared settings.
scenes.say: Don't fall for this: not every module needs a full POM. Modules can inherit settings from a parent, making project management much easier.
